records.statement: Fork compression standard: 11 clicks out from fully in (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: An owner's-manual copy and repeated magazine test bikes agree on 11 clicks out. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Fork rebound standard: 13 clicks out from fully in (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: The owner's-manual copy gives 13 clicks out; magazine testers run 13 out and describe rebound as left at stock. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.topic: shock clicker standard settings (four-way KYB shock)
records.statement: Shock standard settings, counted out from fully in: low-speed compression 14 clicks, high-speed compression 14 clicks, low-speed rebound 14 clicks, high-speed rebound (on the shock clevis) 16 clicks, where its two punch marks line up (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: The owner's-manual copy lists these as standard; magazine testers run the identical four settings and call the stock shock clickers sound. The four-way layout (high-speed rebound on the clevis) is confirmed by a separate test. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Stock fork spring rate: 5.0 N/mm (0.51 kgf/mm) (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Three independent sources agree. Testers commonly call it stiff for a 250 and fit 4.6-4.9 N/mm for lighter riders. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Stock shock spring rate: 52 N/mm (5.3 kgf/mm) (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Four independent sources agree (owners quote it as 5.3 kg/mm). The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Race (rider) sag standard: 110 mm (4.33 in) (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Three independent sources agree. Testers often run 104-107 mm. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Fork oil quantity standard: 360 ml (12.2 US oz) per leg with the standard spring (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z250, 2019-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: An owner's-manual copy and owner reports agree on 360 ml; owners and tuners often lower it about 20 ml to soften the stiff fork. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Shock standard settings: compression 1-1/2 turns out, rebound 3 turns out from fully in; the BFRC shock has a single compression adjuster and no separate high-speed adjuster (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: The 2021 owner's-manual copy and magazine test bikes agree. A later manual edition (model year not printed) lists 2 turns compression and 1 turn rebound, so these figures are applied only to 2020-2021.

records.statement: Fork compression standard: riders and manual copies list 6-8 clicks out from fully in for the {y} RM-Z450 (not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Sources disagree: the 2021 owner's-manual copy gives 8 clicks out, magazine test bikes list 6 out as stock. Stored as a spread; a later manual edition gives 9 out.

records.statement: Race (rider) sag standard: listed as 105-108 mm for the {y} RM-Z450 (not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Sources disagree: the 2021 owner's-manual copy gives 105 mm, magazine test bikes list 108 mm as stock. A later manual edition and 2023 test bikes use 110 mm.

records.statement: Stock shock spring rate: 54 N/mm (5.5 kgf/mm) (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: The 2021 owner's-manual copy lists part 62211-37K00 as standard in a 52/54/56 N/mm soft/standard/hard table; magazine testers say Suzuki fitted 54 N/mm from 2019. The later manual edition and a 2023 test list 56 N/mm as standard, so this is applied only to 2020-2021.

records.statement: Stock fork spring rate: 5.0 N/mm (0.51 kgf/mm) (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions and an independent test agree. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Fork rebound standard: 11 clicks out from fully in (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions (third-party copies) agree; no independent test confirmation. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.topic: fork oil quantity standard and range
records.statement: Fork oil quantity standard: 365 ml (12.3 US oz) per leg with the standard 5.0 N/mm spring, adjustable range 297-398 ml (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions (third-party copies) agree; no independent confirmation. The 2027 model changed suspension, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Engine oil: about 1050 ml (1.1 US qt) at an oil change, 1100 ml (1.2 US qt) with a filter change; SAE 10W-40, JASO MA (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions (third-party copies) agree.

records.statement: Coolant capacity: 1100 ml (1.2 US qt), 50:50 glycol coolant for aluminium engines with distilled water (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions (third-party copies) agree.

records.statement: Spark plug gap: 0.9-1.0 mm (0.035-0.039 in); the NGK DIMR8C10 comes pre-gapped at 1.0 mm (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Owner's-manual copies and the plug seller's listing agree.

records.statement: Oil filter cap bolt torque: 11 N·m (8.5 lbf-ft) (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions (third-party copies) agree.

records.statement: Drive chain slack: 35-45 mm (1.4-1.7 in), measured midway between the chain buffer and rear sprocket with the rear wheel off the ground (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Two separate owner's-manual editions (third-party copies) agree. The 2027 model changed suspension and chassis parts, so this is not applied to 2027.

records.statement: Stock gearing: 13-tooth front, 50-tooth rear sprocket on a 520 chain (commonly listed for the {y} RM-Z450, 2018-2026 platform; not from a Suzuki-published source).
records.notes: Magazine test bikes list 13/50 as stock and OEM-spec replacement kits for the RM-Z450 are sized 13/50. Testers commonly go one tooth larger on the rear (51). The 2027 model changed suspension and chassis parts, so this is not applied to 2027.
